recipes.label: Create a Distraction?
recipes.startdescription: The fires of the corrivalty burn hot here. Too hot, and it may attract unwanted attention. I can have some scouts and fighting men create a distraction with enough resources. [Provide Scouts and at least 16 Edge to do this.]

recipes.label: Order men to create a diversion in the battlefield
recipes.startdescription: The enemy assault grows fiercer and fiercer. If I have some scouts and fighting men to spare, I can order them to create a diversion to attract attention.
recipes.description: Blood for Time. A little more sand in the hourglass.
